ui.title: My homelab
ui.intro: The machines I keep at home to host my projects, store backups and learn systems administration. I set them up, configure them and monitor them myself.
ui.privacy: I don't publish addresses, ports or versions: only what each machine does.

live.label: Status now
live.note: Service status is checked every minute by Uptime Kuma from inside the network.

ui.footer: This page is served by the Raspberry Pi too.
